en.hubeali: And from him, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abu Al Jaroud who said,
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is none from the things more hateful to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic than a (completely) filled belly’.
en.sarwar: 11. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Muhammad ibn Sinan from abu al-Jarud who has said the following:
“Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Nothing walks as hated in the sight of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, as a full stomach.’”
